data.body: Investigation: enforcement-gate.sh IS already fixed at HEAD by commit ab071e8104 (UPDATE: enforcement-gate.sh reads dso.workflow instead of enforcement.strategy, task c9d5). Empirical test in this worktree confirms 'HOOK_GATE: skipped reason=dso.workflow=ci-pr' and the gate returns 0 (short-circuits). The symptom observed during the f6fd commit was due to the STALE PLUGIN CACHE at ~/.claude/plugins/cache/... still serving the pre-shim version. The cache is what fires during pre-commit hooks. The worktree file is correct. Recommendation: close as already-fixed.
